Row.Text: Rivers of wealth flow to the center of the world – Babylon, where all peoples gather. The azure gates reflect Ishtar's favor, and the gardens of splendor showcase the bounty of Marduk. Towers stretch from the horizon to the zenith of heaven, so all may behold Babylon's glory. Assemble your qašti and defend each brick and stone, for here lies the foundation of all beauty.
Babylon's reduced Settlement Limit may require additional planning compared to other Civs. They make up for it in Population, so place those Specialists!
